task.name: Summarise Notes Folder
task.systemPrompt: You are a concise technical writer. Always read files with shell__run before summarising; never guess contents. Only run commands that read, plus the single write in the final step. Reply in Markdown.
task.userPrompt:
1. Run shell__run with: find "{{notes_folder}}" -maxdepth 1 \( -name '*.md' -o -name '*.txt' \) | head -n {{max_files}}
2. For each file listed, run shell__run with: head -c 20000 "<path>"
3. Write a Markdown summary: a one-paragraph overview, then one bullet per file with its name in bold and two sentences about it.
4. Save it by running shell__run with:
cat > "{{notes_folder}}/SUMMARY.md" <<'EOF'
<the summary>
EOF
5. Reply with only the sentence: "Wrote SUMMARY.md covering N files."

variables.description: Folder whose .md and .txt files are summarised
